summary: All 3 new features (curve tool, eraser, share-sheet) and regression flows pass on the Expo web preview at 390x844 with localStorage cleared. ToolPicker shows the correct option sets for dot mode (line/curve/free/erase) and free mode (free/curve/erase); the toggle label updates to Join dots/Curve/Brush/Eraser and the picker closes on pick. Curve strokes render SVG <path> d-attributes containing cubic bezier 'C' commands. Eraser strokes render with stroke color equal to the current floor (#3D261D first, then #FFF9F2 after tapping canvas-floor-btn — eraseLikeCount stays 1 across the floor change); dot circles remain on top (49 for 7x7) and canvas-undo-btn removes the erase stroke. ShareSheet renders with 'Download image' + 'Share (WhatsApp & more)' + close; both buttons trigger a rangoli.png web download, share-share-btn also shows the 'Image downloaded' toast while share-save-photos-btn shows 'Saved to your Photos'. Saving an artwork with curve+erase strokes and reopening it from the gallery preserves cubic beziers and renders them in the thumbnail. Regression confirmed for join-dots, brush, save/toast, exit sheet (prior iteration) and gallery delete; zero /api requests were made during the entire session (fully offline). No console errors or pageerrors. Shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings ignored per note.
critical_code_review_comments: ShareSheet.tsx imports from 'expo-media-library/legacy' — the legacy entry still works but is a deprecation path; consider migrating to the current expo-media-library default export when convenient (not blocking).
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted ephemeral TEST_rangoli_1 and TEST_delete_me artworks in localStorage; gallery ends empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport 390x844. Always await page.evaluate('() => localStorage.clear()') after first load and reload before testing. Use the inner SVG under [data-testid=drawing-canvas] when sampling dot positions (there are many phosphor-icon SVGs elsewhere in the DOM). The eraser produces a path with stroke === background (test by reading <rect fill> on the drawing SVG). On web, Sharing.isAvailableAsync() returns false, so share-share-btn falls back to download + 'Image downloaded' toast. Dot setup → start → canvas uses dot-setup-start-btn. Save flow: save-name-input + save-confirm-btn → canvas-toast 'Saved on device'. Gallery delete: trash is gallery-delete-{id}; the dialog container is gallery-delete-confirm, confirm action is gallery-delete-confirm-btn (don't match loosely).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
